newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE SET SOUTH AFRICA 227-RUN TARGET.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE SET SOUTH AFRICA 227-RUN TARGET.

text.p: Zimbabwe recovered from losing Grant Flower for nought to the third ball of the innings to set South Africa a 227-run target in their triangular series one-day match on Wednesday.
On a bouncy Newlands wicket unusually tinged with green only Flower failed to reach double figures against the home side's vaunted four-pronged pace attack.
Zimbabwe relied on a team effort to reach 226 for six.
Their final two partnerships put on 102 from 91 balls to lift the scoring rate, with coach David Houghton batting at number seven leading the charge with an undefeated 57 from 44 balls.
Opener Andy Waller scored 52 from 85 balls, skipper Alistair Campbell 30 and Guy Whittall 26 not out.
